name: Unmatched Reason 4 Code
definition: Specifies the reason the transaction, transfer or settlement instruction is unmatched.

ADEA.name: Account Servicer Deadline Missed
ADEA.definition: Received after the account servicer's deadline. Processed on best effort basis.

CADE.name: Repurchase Call Delay
CADE.definition: Transaction call delay does not match.

CMIS.name: No Match
CMIS.definition: A matching instruction from your counterparty could not be found.

DELN.name: Transaction Direction
DELN.definition: Direction of the trade does not match. Counterparty expects a delivery from you, not a receipt or vice versa.

DQUA.name: Financial Instrument Quantity
DQUA.definition: Quantity of financial instruments does not match.

DSEC.name: Financial Instrument
DSEC.definition: Financial instrument identification does not match, for example, ISIN, financial instrument attributes differs.

EXEC.name: Execution Broker Commission
EXEC.definition: Executing broker's commission does not match.

LATE.name: Market Deadline Missed
LATE.definition: Your instruction was too late for matching.

LEOG.name: Letter Of Guarantee
LEOG.definition: Counterparty is for settlement through letter of guarantee, your instruction is not, or vice versa.

MCAN.name: Matching Record Cancelled
MCAN.definition: Corresponding matching record has been cancelled.

NARR.name: Narrative Reason
NARR.definition: See narrative field for the reason.

PHYS.name: Physical Settlement
PHYS.definition: Counterparty's instruction is physical settlement, your instruction is not, or vice versa.

PLCE.name: Place Of Trade
PLCE.definition: Place of trade does not match.

PODU.name: Possible Duplicate
PODU.definition: Instruction has not been matched. It is a possible duplicate instruction.

REPA.name: Repurchase Amount
REPA.definition: Termination transaction amount does not match.

RERT.name: Repurchase Rate Type
RERT.definition: Repurchase rate type does not match.

RTGS.name: RTGS System
RTGS.definition: Counterparty is for Real Time Gross Settlement (RTGS) system, you are for non-RTGS or vice versa.

SAFE.name: Safekeeping Account
SAFE.definition: Safekeeping account used as matching criteria on the market concerned does not match. This includes Buyer/seller's account, direct client's account at the receiving/delivering agent, or receiving/delivering agent's account at the CSD.

SETR.name: Settlement Transaction
SETR.definition: Settlement transaction type does not match (relates to the settlement transaction type codes available for field: 22F:: SETR.).

SETS.name: Settlement System Method
SETS.definition: Settlement system/method does not match (for example, instruction is to settle using settlement system/method A. Counterparty expects settlement to occur using settlement system/method B).

TXST.name: Tax Status
TXST.definition: Disagreement on the tax status of the financial instruments to be settled.

VASU.name: Variable Rate Support
VASU.definition: Variable rate support does not match (repo).

COAX.name: Consumption Tax
COAX.definition: Consumption tax amount does not match.

OTHI.name: Other Financial Instrument Identification
OTHI.definition: OtherIdentification of financial instrument identification does not match.

TACR.name: Accrued Interest Tax 1
TACR.definition: Accrued interest tax indicator does not match.

SDAT.name: Settlement Date 2
SDAT.definition: Settlement date in the second leg does not match.

SCRA.name: Standard Collateral Ratio
SCRA.definition: Standard collateral ratio does not match.

ACRU.name: Accrued Interest Amount 1
ACRU.definition: Accrued interest amount does not match.

SHAI.name: Securities Haircut
SHAI.definition: Securities haircut rate does not match.

ACRS.name: Accrued Interest Amount 2
ACRS.definition: Accrued interest amount in the second leg does not match.

DEAS.name: Deal Amount 2
DEAS.definition: Deal amount in the second leg does not match.

TACS.name: Accrued Interest Tax 2
TACS.definition: Accrued interest tax indicator in the second leg does not match.

DBNM.name: Standing Settlement Instruction
DBNM.definition: Counterparty's instruction is for settlement through standing settlement instruction, your instruction is not, or vice versa.

TRSA.name: Closing Settlement Amount
TRSA.definition: Closing settlement amount does not match.

TRTE.name: Type Of Financing Closing
TRTE.definition: Type of financing closing does not match.

BOIA.name: Borrowing Interest Amount
BOIA.definition: Borrowing interest amount does not match.

TRTR.name: Trade Transaction Type
TRTR.definition: Trade transaction type does not match.

LTME.name: Lending Transaction Method
LTME.definition: Lending transaction method does not match.

CLSE.name: Clearing Segment
CLSE.definition: Counterparty's instruction is for settlement through clearing segment, your instruction is not, or vice versa.
